plugin.name: Player (recommended)
plugin.description:
Plugin doctor, environment report, address check and crash breadcrumbs. A message box appears at start-up while something needs attention (a problem that may crash the game, or an F4SE plugin that is not running); its Don't show button silences the plugins it listed. The full report is in Documents\My Games\Fallout4\F4SE\Vitals\Vitals-Report.txt.
Note: reinstalling replaces Vitals.ini, so copy any settings you changed first.

plugin.name: Mod author / developer
plugin.description: Everything in Player, plus the developer options: a list of every Papyrus native function and the DLL that registered it, and the engine layout probes. Logs are larger and start-up is slightly slower. Use this when you write or port F4SE plugins.

plugin.name: No thanks
plugin.description: Vitals keeps everything on your PC, as always. You can change your mind later: reinstall and pick the other option, or set bSharePack=1 in Vitals.ini.

plugin.name: Yes, help improve Vitals
plugin.description:
Vitals saves a log pack (Vitals-Share.zip) on your PC after each session, with your user name, PC name, emails, IP addresses, keys and private paths scrubbed out. Vitals never sends it.
To help: join https://discord.gg/XghtBZUFNW, press Send my pack, and drag Vitals-Share.zip (it is in Documents\My Games\Fallout4\F4SE\Vitals) into the private channel. Only the maintainer can see it. Full details: https://github.com/trvxoo-glitch/defib-vitals-public/blob/main/docs/PRIVACY_AND_SAFETY.md#the-share-pack-opt-in-off-by-default
